purpose: Registry of independently verified primary sources for technical claims

acceptedEvidence: official standard or normative document with edition and applicability
official technical datasheet with manufacturer and conditions
primary scientific publication with DOI and scope
official professional qualification or education requirement
rules: Do not mark source as verified merely because a URL exists.
Link each technical claim to a specific source and applicable edition.
A source may support only claims within its scope and conditions.
Unknown data must remain unknown rather than inferred.
